description: Empirical completed-match samples; generated fixtures, player ratings and simulated results are separate.

model.name: Poisson with bounded Dixon–Coles low-score correction

borrowedHomeShare.method: Pooled home goals / all goals in the six dated South American result samples; borrowed, not measured for the target league.

model.note: Implementation adapts a published family of models; parameters are fitted to these samples, not supplied by the paper.

limitations: Phases and seasons have different coverage; phase samples are explicitly labelled.
No sampled league has empirical xG or injury observations in this dataset.
Lower divisions without their own sample borrow a labelled top-division reference; this is a simulation estimate.

leagues.name: Primera División de Chile
leagues.title: Chile 2025
leagues.caveat: Primera tabla de la primera división publicada por RSSSF: temporada completa de Chile, fase regular de Ecuador, Apertura regular de Colombia/Venezuela. Goles y empates se derivan de partidos jugados y balances de los clubes; no hay marcadores individuales ni reparto local/visitante. La localía del modelo es una estimación explícita.
